requirement_text.ISS-0332: REQ-077 bumps the DEFINITION_PROMOTED platform-event-type seed from schema_version 1 (review_id required non-null) to schema_version 2 (review_id nullable) in lib/letflow/tenant_provisioning.ex, to support R10 (Promotion.promote_active_definition/5, ENV-03 review-less promote path). This seed only applies to tenants provisioned from this point forward -- nothing re-runs replay_migrations/2 or re-registers the type for already-provisioned tenants, whose event_type_registry still validates against v1. R10 against such a tenant commits the promotion transaction, then fails the event-append step on schema validation -- a committed write reported as failure (design req077-promotion-pipeline-routes.md section F-5.2 Severity 1 shape). Needs a backfill routine (e.g. a Mix task iterating tenant_schemas and calling Letflow.EventStore.Registry.register_type/2 per tenant, no-op on an already-higher-version collision) -- should go through CODE-DESIGNER before implementation. Affected files: lib/letflow/tenant_provisioning.ex (~769-809, existing KNOWN GAP comment), lib/letflow/event_store/registry.ex.
